notes:
{教会|きょうかい} refers to a Christian church building or congregation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {教会|きょうかい}に{行|い}く: to go to church
- {教会|きょうかい}で{結婚式|けっこんしき}を{挙|あ}げる: to have a wedding at a church
- {教会|きょうかい}{音楽|おんがく}: church music

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, church weddings are popular even among non-Christians due to their romantic aesthetic. Many wedding halls have chapel-style venues.
